hook.convey: two same-size wholes → same denominator: parts the same size, so the count of parts decides; same numerator: the count is the same, so the size of a part decides → a cake in pieces, a game's download bar in equal boxes

use.hi: Do ek jaise cake socho: ek 8 barabar tukdon mein bata hai, ek 12 mein. Dono se 3-3 tukde uthao, toh plate par tukdon ki ginti barabar hai, par tukdon ka size barabar nahi.

use.hi: Game ka download bar 10 barabar khaanon mein bata hota hai. Do baar ka download dekho, toh dono mein khaane ek hi size ke hain, sirf bhare khaanon ki ginti badalti hai.

explain.convey: same denominator → every gap on the 0-1 line is the same 1/9 → 2/9 = 2 gaps from 0, 7/9 = 7 gaps from 0 → the point further from 0 is the bigger fraction

point.hi: Is sankhya rekha par 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gap hain, har gap 1/9. 2/9 matlab 0 se 2 gap aage, aur 7/9 matlab 0 se 7 gap aage. 7/9 ka nishaan 1 ke kaafi paas hai, aur 2/9 ka nishaan 0 ke paas.
point.en: On this number line there are 9 equal gaps from 0 to 1, each gap 1/9. 2/9 means 2 gaps on from 0, and 7/9 means 7 gaps on from 0. The 7/9 mark is quite close to 1, and the 2/9 mark is close to 0.

prompt.hi: Isi 9 gap wali line par 4/9 aur 8/9 socho. Kaunsa bada hai: 4/9 ya 8/9?
prompt.en: On this same line of 9 gaps, think of 4/9 and 8/9. Which is bigger: 4/9 or 8/9?

why.hi: dono mein gap ek hi size ke hain, aur 8 gap 4 gap se aage, isliye 8/9 bada
why.en: the gaps are the same size in both, and 8 gaps reach further than 4, so 8/9 is bigger

simpler.hi: Line 9 barabar gap mein hai, har gap 1/9. 2/9 matlab 0 se 2 gap, 7/9 matlab 7 gap, isliye 7/9 aage hai.
simpler.en: The line has 9 equal gaps, each gap 1/9. 2/9 is 2 gaps from 0 and 7/9 is 7 gaps, so 7/9 is further along.

explain.convey: same numerator → the same number of parts, so the size of a part decides; one 0-1 line in tenths: 2 tenths reach only the 2nd mark after 0, while 2 fifths (each fifth = 2 tenths) reach the 4th mark after 0; the child transfers to 3/5 vs 3/10

point.hi: Is line par 0 se 1 tak 10 barabar gap hain. 2/10 matlab sirf 2 chhote gap, 0 ke baad doosra nishaan. Agar yahi 0 se 1 sirf 5 hisson mein bata hota, toh har hissa 2 chhote gap ke barabar hota. Isliye 2/5 = 4/10, 0 ke baad chautha nishaan. Dono mein 2 hisse hain, par 2/5 ka nishaan aage hai.
point.en: On this line there are 10 equal gaps from 0 to 1. 2/10 means just 2 small gaps, the 2nd mark after 0. If the same 0 to 1 were shared into only 5 parts, each part would equal 2 small gaps. So 2/5 = 4/10, the 4th mark after 0. Both have 2 parts, but the 2/5 mark is further along.

prompt.hi: Isi line par upar 3/5 aur neeche 3/10 lo. Kaunsa bada hai: 3/5 ya 3/10?

why.hi: 3/5 = 6/10, aur 6 chhote gap 3 chhote gap se aage hain

simpler.hi: Line 10 chhote gap mein hai. 0 se 1 ko sirf 5 hisson mein baanto, toh har hissa 2 chhote gap ka, isliye 2/5 = 4/10.
simpler.en: The line has 10 small gaps. Share 0 to 1 into just 5 parts and each part is 2 small gaps, so 2/5 = 4/10.

prompt.hi: Farhan ne kitaab ka 3/4 padha, Anjali ne usi kitaab ka 7/8. Zyada kisne padha: Farhan ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar?
prompt.en: Farhan read 3/4 of a book, Anjali read 7/8 of the same book. Who read more: Farhan, Anjali, or both the same?

why.hi: 3/4 = 6/8, aur 7/8 6/8 se zyada hai
why.en: 3/4 = 6/8, and 7/8 is more than 6/8

simpler.hi: 3/4 ke upar aur neeche ko do se guna karo, taaki neeche 7/8 jaisa ho jaaye. Phir upar ke numbers milao.
simpler.en: Multiply the top and bottom of 3/4 by two, so its bottom matches 7/8. Then compare the top numbers.

bridgeToNext.hi: Common denominator hamesha kaam karta hai. Agle hisse mein ek tez raasta dekhenge: bhinn ko 1/2 aur 1 se milana.
bridgeToNext.en: A common denominator always works. In the next part we will see a quicker way: comparing fractions with 1/2 and 1.

hook.convey: a whole with a halfway mark → is the amount below or above half → one below and one above settles the comparison with no long working; a rocket's fuel tank, a jug in the kitchen

use.hi: Do ek jaise rocket hain. Agar ek ka fuel tank aadhe se zyada bhara hai aur doosre ka aadhe se kam, toh pehle rocket mein zyada fuel hai, bina lambe hisaab ke.
use.en: There are two identical rockets. If one rocket's fuel tank is more than half full and the other's is less than half, the first rocket has more fuel, with no long working.

use.hi: Kitchen mein do ek jaise jug hain, dono par beech mein aadhe ka nishaan hai. Dono jug ko us nishaan se milao, toh turant pata chal jaata hai ki kismein zyada doodh hai.
use.en: In the kitchen there are two same-size jugs, each with a halfway mark. Check both jugs against that mark, and you know at once which has more milk.

explain.convey: 1/2 on a line of tenths = 5/10, because half of 10 is 5 → compare the numerator with half the denominator, not with the 1 of 1/2 → 3/10 has 3 < 5 → before 1/2; the child places 4/10

point.hi: Is line par 0 se 1 tak 10 barabar gap hain. 10 ka aadha 5 hai, isliye beech ka nishaan 5/10 hai, yaani 1/2. 3/10 mein 3, 5 se kam hai, toh 3/10 ka nishaan 1/2 se pehle hai.
point.en: On this line there are 10 equal gaps from 0 to 1. Half of 10 is 5, so the middle mark is 5/10, that is 1/2. In 3/10, 3 is less than 5, so the 3/10 mark is before 1/2.

prompt.hi: Isi line par 4/10 kahan aata hai: 1/2 se pehle ya 1/2 ke baad?
prompt.en: On this same line, where does 4/10 come: before 1/2 or after 1/2?

why.hi: 10 ka aadha 5 hai, aur 4, 5 se kam hai
why.en: half of 10 is 5, and 4 is less than 5

simpler.hi: 10 ka aadha 5 hai, toh beech ka nishaan 5/10, yaani 1/2. 3/10 mein 3, 5 se chhota hai, isliye woh beech tak nahi pahunchta.
simpler.en: Half of 10 is 5, so the middle mark is 5/10, that is 1/2. In 3/10, 3 is smaller than 5, so it does not reach the middle.

explain.convey: odd denominator: half of 7 is 3.5 → 1/2 falls between 3/7 and 4/7 → 4 > 3.5 so 4/7 is past half; the child tests 2/7 (a numerator above 1 that is still below half)

point.hi: Ab line par 7 barabar gap hain. 7 ka aadha 3.5 hai, toh 1/2 ka nishaan 3/7 aur 4/7 ke theek beech mein padta hai. 4/7 mein 4, 3.5 se bada hai, toh 4/7 aadhe ke baad hai.
point.en: Now the line has 7 equal gaps. Half of 7 is 3.5, so the 1/2 point falls exactly between 3/7 and 4/7. In 4/7, 4 is more than 3.5, so 4/7 is after half.

prompt.hi: Isi line par 2/7, 1/2 se zyada hai ya kam?
prompt.en: On this same line, is 2/7 more than 1/2 or less?

why.hi: 7 ka aadha 3.5 hai, aur 2, 3.5 se kam hai
why.en: half of 7 is 3.5, and 2 is less than 3.5

simpler.hi: Ab line 7 gap mein hai, aur 7 ka aadha 3.5 hai. 4/7 mein 4, 3.5 se bada hai, isliye 4/7 aadhe ke baad aata hai.
simpler.en: Now the line has 7 gaps, and half of 7 is 3.5. In 4/7, 4 is bigger than 3.5, so 4/7 comes after half.

explain.convey: two fractions on either side of 1/2 → no common denominator needed: 2/6 is below half (2 < 3), 7/10 is above half (7 > 5); the child transfers to 4/6 vs 3/10, where the bigger denominator is the smaller fraction

point.hi: Pehle 2/6 lo: 6 ka aadha 3 hai, aur 2, 3 se kam hai, toh 2/6 aadhe se neeche hai. Ab 7/10: 10 ka aadha 5 hai, aur 7, 5 se zyada hai, toh 7/10 aadhe se upar hai. Ek 1/2 se neeche aur ek upar ho, toh common denominator ki zaroorat hi nahi.
point.en: First take 2/6: half of 6 is 3, and 2 is less than 3, so 2/6 is below half. Now 7/10: half of 10 is 5, and 7 is more than 5, so 7/10 is above half. When one is below 1/2 and one is above, no common denominator is needed at all.

prompt.hi: Ab 4/6 aur 3/10 lo. Kaunsa bada hai: 4/6 ya 3/10?
prompt.en: Now take 4/6 and 3/10. Which is bigger: 4/6 or 3/10?

why.hi: 4/6 mein 4, 6 ke aadhe 3 se zyada hai, par 3/10 mein 3, 10 ke aadhe 5 se kam
why.en: in 4/6, 4 is more than 3, half of 6, but in 3/10, 3 is less than 5, half of 10

simpler.hi: 2/6 mein 2, 3 se chhota hai, toh woh aadhe se neeche. 7/10 mein 7, 5 se bada hai, toh aadhe se upar, aur bina common denominator ke pata chal gaya.
simpler.en: In 2/6, 2 is smaller than 3, so it is below half. In 7/10, 7 is bigger than 5, so it is above half, with no common denominator needed.

explain.convey: 1 is a benchmark too: numerator smaller than denominator → before 1, bigger → after 1; a 0-2 line in eighths: 7/8 before 1, 5/4 = 10/8 after 1; the child transfers to 3/4 vs 9/8

point.hi: Yeh line 0 se 2 tak hai, har 1 mein 8 barabar gap. 7/8 mein 7, 8 se chhota hai, toh 7/8 ka nishaan 1 se pehle hai. 5/4 yahan 10/8 par aata hai: 5, 4 se bada hai, toh 5/4 ka nishaan 1 ke baad hai.
point.en: This line goes from 0 to 2, with 8 equal gaps in each 1. In 7/8, 7 is smaller than 8, so the 7/8 mark is before 1. 5/4 comes at 10/8 here: 5 is bigger than 4, so the 5/4 mark is after 1.

prompt.hi: Ab 3/4 aur 9/8 lo. Kaunsa bada hai: 3/4 ya 9/8?
prompt.en: Now take 3/4 and 9/8. Which is bigger: 3/4 or 9/8?

why.hi: 9/8 mein 9, 8 se bada hai toh woh 1 ke baad hai, par 3/4 1 se pehle hai
why.en: in 9/8, 9 is bigger than 8 so it is past 1, but 3/4 is before 1

simpler.hi: 7/8 mein 7, 8 se chhota hai, toh 7/8 abhi 1 tak nahi pahuncha. 5/4 mein 5, 4 se bada hai, toh 5/4 1 ke aage hai.
simpler.en: In 7/8, 7 is smaller than 8, so 7/8 has not reached 1. In 5/4, 5 is bigger than 4, so 5/4 is past 1.

problem.hi: Do ek jaisi paani ki bottle hain. Anil ki bottle 5/12 bhari hai aur Bina ki 7/13. 1/2 ko benchmark lekar, bina common denominator ke, batao kiski bottle mein zyada paani hai.
problem.en: There are two same-size water bottles. Anil's bottle is 5/12 full and Bina's is 7/13 full. Using 1/2 as a benchmark, with no common denominator, tell whose bottle has more water.

givens.hi: dono bottle ek hi size ki hain
givens.en: both bottles are the same size

find.hi: kiski bottle mein zyada paani hai

why.hi: aadha matlab poore ke do barabar hisse
why.en: half means two equal parts of the whole

simpler.hi: 12 ka aadha 6 hai, isliye aadha matlab 6/12.
simpler.en: Half of 12 is 6, so a half is 6/12.

why.hi: 5 hisse aadhe ke 6 hisson se kam hain
why.en: 5 parts are fewer than the 6 parts of a half

simpler.hi: Anil ke 5/12 mein upar 5 hai, aadhe ke liye 6 chahiye. 5, 6 se chhota hai, isliye 5/12 aadhe se kam hai.
simpler.en: Anil's 5/12 has 5 on top, and a half needs 6. 5 is smaller than 6, so 5/12 is less than half.

why.hi: 13 ko do barabar hisson mein baanto toh har hissa 6.5 aata hai
why.en: sharing 13 into two equal parts gives 6.5 in each

simpler.hi: 13 ka aadha 6.5 hai.
simpler.en: Half of 13 is 6.5.

why.hi: 7, 6.5 se bada hai
why.en: 7 is more than 6.5

simpler.hi: Bina ke 7/13 mein upar 7 hai, aadhe ke liye 6.5 chahiye. 7 bada hai, isliye 7/13 aadhe se zyada hai.
simpler.en: Bina's 7/13 has 7 on top, and a half needs 6.5. 7 is bigger, so 7/13 is more than half.

prompt.hi: Ab dono ko aadhe se mila liya. Toh kiski bottle mein zyada paani hai: Anil ki ya Bina ki?
prompt.en: Now both are compared with a half. So whose bottle has more water: Anil's or Bina's?

simpler.hi: Ek bottle aadhe se kam bhari hai, doosri aadhe se zyada. Jo aadhe se upar hai, usmein zyada paani hai.
simpler.en: One bottle is less than half full, the other more than half. The one above half has more water.

why.hi: Anil ka 5/12, 12 ka aadha 6 se kam hai; Bina ka 7/13, 13 ka aadha 6.5 se zyada hai
why.en: 5/12 is below half and 7/13 is above half, so Bina's bottle has more

answer.hi: Bina ki bottle mein zyada paani hai

why.hi: 5/12 aadhe se kam hai aur 7/13 aadhe se zyada, isliye 7/13 bada hai
why.en: 5/12 is less than half and 7/13 is more than half, so 7/13 is bigger

prompt.hi: 4/9, 1/2 se zyada hai ya kam?
prompt.en: Is 4/9 more than 1/2 or less?

why.hi: 9 ka aadha 4.5 hai, aur 4, 4.5 se kam hai
why.en: half of 9 is 4.5, and 4 is less than 4.5

simpler.hi: 4/9 ke neeche wale number ka aadha nikalo. Phir upar wale number ko us aadhe se milao.
simpler.en: Find half of the bottom number of 4/9. Then compare the top number with that half.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise jug hain. Rahul ka jug 2/3 bhara hai, Sana ka 5/11. 1/2 se milakar batao, kiska jug zyada bhara hai: Rahul ka ya Sana ka?
prompt.en: There are two same-size jugs. Rahul's jug is 2/3 full, Sana's is 5/11 full; using 1/2, tell whose jug is fuller: Rahul's or Sana's?

why.hi: 2/3 mein 2, 3 ke aadhe 1.5 se zyada hai, par 5/11 mein 5, 11 ke aadhe 5.5 se kam
why.en: in 2/3, 2 is more than 1.5, half of 3, but in 5/11, 5 is less than 5.5, half of 11

simpler.hi: Har bhinn ke neeche wale number ka aadha nikalo. Dekho upar wala number us aadhe se bada hai ya chhota.
simpler.en: For each fraction, find half of the bottom number. See whether the top number is bigger or smaller than that half.

prompt.hi: Gopi ne 7/6 litre paani piya aur Anjali ne 11/12 litre. 1 litre se milakar batao, zyada kisne piya: Gopi ne ya Anjali ne?
prompt.en: Gopi drank 7/6 litre of water and Anjali drank 11/12 litre. Using 1 litre, tell who drank more: Gopi or Anjali?

why.hi: Gopi ke 7/6 mein 7, 6 se bada hai, toh 1 litre se zyada; Anjali ka 11/12 1 litre se kam hai
why.en: in 7/6, 7 is bigger than 6 so it is more than 1 litre, but 11/12 is less than 1 litre

simpler.hi: Jab upar ka number neeche wale se bada ho, toh bhinn 1 se zyada hota hai. Dono bhinn ko isi tarah parkho.
simpler.en: When the top number is bigger than the bottom, the fraction is more than 1. Test both fractions this way.

ladder.why: benchmark compare: 3/7 below half, 5/8 above half
benchmark with no common denominator allowed: 11/20 vs 4/9 of the tickets
far transfer: two win fractions, 7/10 vs 5/8, both above half, so a common denominator is still needed

remediation.move: 0-1 line in sixths → half of 6 is 3 → 1/2 sits on 3/6 → 2/6 lands left of it → the test is the numerator against half the denominator, never against the 1 in 1/2

say.hi: 1/2 ko upar ke 1 se mat milao. Line par 1/2 ka nishaan wahan hai jahan neeche ke number ka aadha ho. Jiska upar ka number usse kam ho, woh 1/2 se pehle aata hai.
say.en: Do not check against the 1 on top of 1/2. The 1/2 mark is where half of the bottom number is. A fraction whose top number is less than that comes before 1/2.

simpler.hi: Neeche ke number ka aadha hi 1/2 ka nishaan hai.
simpler.en: Half of the bottom number is the 1/2 mark.

prompt.hi: 8 barabar gap wali line par 3/8 kahan hai: 1/2 se pehle ya 1/2 ke baad?
prompt.en: On a line of 8 equal gaps, where is 3/8: before 1/2 or after 1/2?

why.hi: 8 ka aadha 4 hai, aur 3, 4 se kam hai
why.en: half of 8 is 4, and 3 is less than 4

simpler.hi: 8 ka aadha nikalo, wahi beech ka nishaan hai. Phir dekho 3/8 ka upar wala number usse chhota hai ya bada.
simpler.en: Find half of 8; that is the middle mark. Then see whether the top number of 3/8 is smaller or bigger than it.

remediation.move: read each fraction as one amount against the half mark: 4/9 → 4 < 4.5 → below half; 5/8 → 5 > 4 → above half → the one above half is bigger, whatever its top and bottom numbers look like

say.hi: Upar aur neeche ke number alag-alag mat milao. Har bhinn ka upar wala number uske neeche ke aadhe se milao: kam ho toh aadhe se neeche, zyada ho toh aadhe se upar.
say.en: Do not compare the top and bottom numbers separately. Compare each top number with half of its bottom number: less means below half, more means above half.

simpler.hi: Upar wale ko neeche ke aadhe se milao.
simpler.en: Compare the top with half of the bottom.

prompt.hi: Rahul ne deewar ka 4/10 rang kiya, Isha ne usi deewar ka 3/5. 1/2 se milakar batao: zyada kisne, Rahul ya Isha?
prompt.en: Rahul painted 4/10 of a wall, Isha painted 3/5 of the same wall; using 1/2, tell who painted more: Rahul or Isha?

why.hi: 3/5 mein 3, 5 ke aadhe 2.5 se zyada hai, par 4/10 mein 4, 10 ke aadhe 5 se kam
why.en: in 3/5, 3 is more than 2.5, half of 5, but in 4/10, 4 is less than 5, half of 10

simpler.hi: Har bhinn ke neeche wale number ka aadha nikalo. Dekho upar wala number us aadhe se bada hai ya chhota.
simpler.en: For each fraction, find half of the bottom number. See whether the top number is bigger or smaller than that half.
